limitations: Descriptive sensitivity of saved retrieval personalization to reversed option order only; no prediction scores or labels were read.
Does not attribute prediction flips to retrieval changes or establish causal effects.
Exact-span Jaccard is sensitive to truncation boundaries and source identity; it is not semantic similarity.
Option-order pairs, methods and caps are repeated views of the same small target panel,not new independent research judgments.
Pinned completed artifacts were read; no profiles,embeddings or model outputs were regenerated.

metric_recipe.canonical_json_digest: SHA256(compact sorted-key JSON ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False UTF8)
metric_recipe.counts: raw list lengths and distinct set cardinalities both retained
metric_recipe.pair_id_sha256: canonical_json_digest({researcher_id:original_string,context_sha256:SHA256(raw context UTF8),option_text_sha256s:sorted([SHA256(each raw option UTF8)])}); excludes source_condition
metric_recipe.pairing: exact context plus unordered distinct option strings; exactly two literal reverse-order items/group; seven groups/researcher; left/right preserve release.items order
metric_recipe.personalization: frozen f6 contracts.render_content(profile.content), compared as UTF8 bytes

published_passage_projection.metric_identity: Equality,multiset and Jaccard metrics were recomputed over original exact tuples(document_id,start,end,SHA256(raw text UTF8)) in memory,not over the published projection hash.
